description: Cisco ASA %ASA-4-733100 threat-detection drop-rate message: prose with a padded bracketed object ('[   192.168.0.1]', '[ Scanning]', '[     Port-5432 5432]') and six numeric fields, some negative. Chosen as the hardest ASA shape: the bracketed object is free text that must stay opaque while the counters stay semantic.

root.pattern: \[(?P<object>[^\]]+)\] drop (?P<rate_id>rate-[0-9]+) exceeded\. Current burst rate is (?P<burst>[0-9]+) per second, max configured rate is (?P<burst_max>-?[0-9]+); Current average rate is (?P<avg>[0-9]+) per second, max configured rate is (?P<avg_max>-?[0-9]+); Cumulative total count is (?P<total>[0-9]+)
